notes.title: Ghosts and Aliens: Together At Last!
notes.notes:
Hi friends! I have a new video game out and it is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41644/Ghosts_and_Galaxy/]in a bundle with Speed Dating for Ghosts![/url] This means if you already own Speed Dating for Ghosts, you can get a better deal on the new game! Neat, right? That's mathematics for ya.

This new game is called [b]Times & Galaxy[/b] and it's a lot bigger! Like a solar system bigger! You play as a robo intern reporter on a news spaceship, where your job is to fly around to various planets to interview subjects and assemble stories about all kinds of weird stuff. We created more than 100 characters for T&G who you can befriend, be-enemy, and question. With branching conversations, assignments, and endings, here's a LOT of game in here. Even some romance and existential dread, because how can I not put in romance and existential dread.

I think it is going to be a fun debate which is weirder: Speed Dating for Ghosts or Times & Galaxy. 

I think if you liked Speed Dating for Ghosts, you'll find plenty to love in Times & Galaxy. Please consider picking it up here on Steam, or if you prefer, your favorite current gen console. I personally recommend playing on the Steamdeck or Switch because then you can play it in bed and on the bus. 

Thanks for your incredible support over all this time. I love making weird games that find their weird audience, and sometimes that can be tricky. The more you can get the word out to other Speed Dating for Ghosts fans, the more minutes I'll be able to sleep every night. So get the word out, but not too much, because I sometimes also have to be awake.

👁️❤️👽➕👻,
Ben

notes.title: The Spooky Peter Pin Set is Here! 👻

Happy October, Ghouls ‘n Goblins! It’s officially the best time of year. And to celebrate, we're excited to announce our very first piece of Real Life merchandise!

In partnership with our friends at Dual Wield Studio, we've created a [url=https://dualwieldstudio.com/products/speed-dating-for-ghosts-spooky-peter-pin-set] limited edition, glow-in-the-dark statement pin set featuring Spooky Peter[/url] from every body’s favorite existential crisis sim [i]Speed Dating For Ghosts[/i].

Spooky Peter knows the importance of vaccinations. The boo-bonic plague got him in 1665, and the good doctor’s not taking any chances with this latest pandemic. Pete hopes you'll show your support for public health by putting him on your denim jacket. Or backpack. Or wherever your finest pins are worn.

notes.title: Slumber Clause
notes.notes:
Hi incredible [i]Speed Dating for Ghosts[/i] fans and well wishers! Ben here. 

I figured you might be interested in what I'm making next! 

It's called [i]Slumber Clause[/i].

The game is a throwback to classic text adventures, with modern choice and narrative mechanics piled on top. And it's extremely, totally, absolutely focused on story.

If you liked [i]Speed Dating for Ghosts[/i], you're probably going to like the heck out of this too. I'm going for a similar weird, sometimes funny, sometimes sad, sometimes spooky vibe, though this one will lean a little more spooky than even Spooky Peter.

Play as a recently-widowed paramedic mom battling a mean case of sleep paralysis. When you're not trying to hold your waking life together, you're navigating surreal dreams of unspeakable beauty and endless possibilities that always seem to end in tragedy.

All the while, a hooded figure stalks you. Collect clues to discover who they are and what they want.

You can read more about the game and demo the prologue for free here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/883240/Slumber_Clause/

If you are interested, please consider wishlisting the game. I'll be releasing it episodically using Steam's Early Access feature, so early supporters will get the best deal. <3

Thank you for your support with my ghost conversation sim. It's encouraged me to make more weird games that aren't like anything else out there, because I now know there's an audience of rad people who might want to play them.

👁❤️👻,
Ben

notes.title: Expansion Release Date and FAQ
notes.notes:
The long-teased, very much free expansion to Speed Dating for Ghosts finally has a release date. The expansion will appear on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/746400/Speed_Dating_for_Ghosts/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://copychaser.itch.io/speeddatingforghosts]itch.io [/url]on Saturday, November 30: the spookiest day of the year.

[b]Note: A previous version of this post set release at November 28, but technical issues forced a delay! Thanks for your patience![/b]

Here are some answers to questions you may have about the whole ordeal:

[b]How can I prepare for the expansion?[/b]
Without giving much away, the expansion concludes the game’s story and happens after you’ve finished playing ghost trivia with Fran. You’ll need to ensure you’ve finished that Fran date but haven’t restarted by erasing your data. If you have erased your data, you’ll need to play to the end of the main game again before you can play the expansion. You may want to do this anyway, as aspects of the expansion change based on choices you make in the main game.

[b]How can I access the expansion content in-game?[/b]
Once you’ve finished the final date with Fran, a tourism pamphlet inviting you to “Go to Hell” will appear on the main menu. Clicking on the pamphlet will take you to the new content.

[b]Is there endgame content?[/b]
Yep! After you’ve dated all the available expansion ghosts, click on the brochure again and see what happens!

[b]If I haven’t finished the main game in my current playthrough, how can I confirm the expansion has downloaded?[/b]
Go to the graveyard. There should be a new set of blanked-out graves accessible via a Beach button at the bottom of the screen. That’s where the new ghost bios will go once you’ve gotten to know ‘em.

[b]Why did it take so dang long to release the expansion?[/b]
Copychaser Games is mostly just me, Ben. Hey. Hi there. I make games like Speed Dating for Ghosts whenever I can find time, between day jobs that keep a roof over my head at studios like BioWare, Remedy, and WB Games Montreal. The last year has been especially trying, as I’ve also balanced work with a number of familial crises and a pretty serious bout of depression. All this to say,  things have unfortunately been slow going. Much slower than I’d like. Don’t worry, though. Things are calming down! Hence the actual release date! And new things on the horizon too (see below)!

[b]What comes next?[/b]
We are planning to release Speed Dating for Ghosts on iOS as well as Nintendo Switch in the coming months. The initial idea was to release complete versions of the game on these new platforms at the same time as the expansion. But that proved a little more complicated than expected, which I guess is to be expected in games (we’ve made games before and should have expected this).

[b]Why iOS and Switch?[/b]
A morning commute or airplane ride can get mighty boring. Why not spend it dating some ghost friends? New platforms also makes the game available to new audiences.

[b]I really like Speed Dating for Ghosts. How can I support your work?[/b]
A surprising number of people have asked this super nice question. <3 I wanna keep things pretty simple: I make a weird game with some friends, and if that weird game is good, maybe people give us a handful of dollars to play it. Since I don’t have a lot of money to spend on anything resembling traditional promotion or marketing, honestly, the best thing you can do beyond buying my weird games is telling your friends about them! This will enable me to make more weird games. And the circle of life continues.

[b]How can I find out about new and upcoming Copychaser Games?[/b]
Follow [url=https://twitter.com/copychasergames]@copychasergames [/url]or [url=https://twitter.com/bengelinas]@bengelinas[/url] on Twitter. I’m hard at work on two new weird games (one about sleep paralysis and one about space journalism). Twitter is a good place to learn how things are going and when things will come out. But Twitter is not everyone’s cup of garbage, so you can also follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/copychaser]Copychaser Games [/url]on Steam.

Looking so so forward to finally releasing new ghosts into the ether! I hope you’ll like them lots.

👁❤️👻,
Ben

notes.title: Rue Morgue's Best Indie Game of 2018
notes.notes:
Legendary horror magazine Rue Morgue has named Speed Dating for Ghosts the Best Indie Game of 2018 in their Jan/Feb issue.

When the magazine reviewed the game back in May, they gave it five skull and crossbones out of five. Or is that skulls and crossbones?

"It may be short and sweet," games editor Evan Millar wrote, "but Speed Dating for Ghosts' one-two punch of stellar writing and refined ambiance make it a debut title that's worth screaming like a banshee for, even to those scared stiff by the thought of playing a visual novel."

Pretty rad.

👁 ❤ 👻, 
Ben

notes.title: Update: v 1.17 live
notes.notes:
I've pushed an update to Speed Dating for Ghosts that fixes and polishes a bunch of things. Please update to get the full ghost dating experience with these fixes:

- A conditional issue has been fixed that was preventing players from seeing full reactivity to rejecting or being rejected by all nine ghosts in a single playthrough. On Steam, this also prevented people from earning the All Dressed Up and Nowhere to Ghost achievement.

- Steph no longer lingers unnaturally long at the end of her date if you tell her "You're dead." She also now makes a noise when she gets mad.

- The "Choose Your Date" images have been updated to better reflect the appearance of the ghosts and the room themes.

- Various minor fixes have been implemented to improve the flow of the text. We also caught a few typos!

Thanks for playing our game. We are thrilled with the spirited reaction to our game.

👁 ❤ 👻,
Ben

notes.title: Update: v 1.16 live
notes.notes:
​Thank you all for playing on launch day. A few small bugs have emerged because that's just how the early days go. We've updated to fix all known issues.

v 1.16 fixes the dramatic reveal at the end of Steph's date and a couple lines in Riley's date that mix up Phantoms and Demons (how did that happen?)

If you find any bugs, please let us know in the discussion forum.

And thanks for playing!

👁 ❤ 👻,
Ben

notes.title: Speed Dating for Ghosts is Out Now!
notes.notes:
After months 'n months of waiting, Speed Dating for Ghosts has flickered into existence on Steam and itch.io just in time for Valentine's Day (widely regarded as the scariest day of the year).

We're pleased to offer the game and soundtrack at a discount for launch. 

We cannot wait for you to get to know some ghosts.

Launches are launches and there are sometimes hiccups. If you run into any issues while you play, please let us know in Steam's community forum thingy or via email: copychasergames at gmail dot com.

Thank you for your support and we'll see you on the other side! 

👁 ❤ 👻,
Ben

notes.title: Speed Dating for Ghosts Launches on Valentine's Day
notes.notes:
We finally have a date for the, um, ghost dates!

*drum roll*

Valentine’s Day!

Speed Dating for Ghosts will be released on Steam and elsewhere this upcoming February 14: the scariest day of the year!

In advance of this decision, gave ourselves two options: 

1. Push hard to release in early December, only to get swallowed up by all the great sales, giant releases, and best of lists.

2. Take some time to polish and refine things before releasing on Valentine's Day, a holiday already devoted to all things insubstantial and terrifying.

Since Halloween came and went, the latter seemed like the better option by far. So it's what we're gonna do!

We've even changed the release date on Steam, so it no longer says "When the Time Has Come"... or "When the Tim..." in search results.

Thanks for all the support so far. We'll be providing regular updates in the coming weeks.

Mostly we just can't wait for you all to meet some weird ghost friends.

👁 ❤ 👻,
Ben

notes.title: Full Steam Ahead!
notes.notes:
As night fell, an eerie steam rolled in, carrying with it an army of ghosts.

Some sought vengeance. Others, simply to party.

Also, Speed Dating for Ghosts now has an official page on the Steam Store! 

We've set the release date to "when its time has come," which seems appropriate for a game about dead people. There are some screenshots to peek at, as well as a nifty little teaser trailer that features a track from the game.

If you're keen on ghosts, please add our game to your wishlist. Also feel free to tweet, post, or otherwise get the word out to anyone who might like to make some spooky friends. It'll help us an awful lot.

We've also got an [url=http://eepurl.com/c9oCI9]email newsletter mailing list thing[/url] for the most hardcore of ghost daters. Sign up for regular dispatches, including the latest news, insight into development, and even some presents!

And that it's for now! More soon.

Or, actually, wait.

More sooOOOooOOoon.

There we go.

👁 ❤ 👻,
Ben
